name: agent-guardrails
description: Guardrails for coding agents that open their own pull requests: a merge gate, a pre-merge check, a CI wait and a duplicate scan. Pre-release.

required_check.title: Required CI check
required_check.description: Name of the CI workflow (or check) a pull request must have green before it merges. Leave empty to use the repository's only workflow; a repository with several workflows then holds every merge until this is set.

notify_command.title: Command to run on each merge authorization
notify_command.description: Optional. Runs each time `mgo <N>` authorizes a merge, with the authorization record as JSON on stdin; for example a script that messages you. Split like a shell command line but run without a shell, and cut off after 5 seconds. Every authorization is also appended to arm-log.jsonl in the plugin's data directory.
